# Sidewalk Stories LA

> Sidewalk Stories LA is an emerging Los Angeles nonprofit initiative developing a youth public-art and sidewalk-safety pilot in Fairfax and Mid-City West.

## Canonical facts
- Website: https://sidewalkstoriesla.org/
- Founder: Trevor Damyan
- Location: Los Angeles, California
- Pilot area: Fairfax and Mid-City West
- Contact: trevor@sidewalkstoriesla.org
- Status: Incorporated as a California nonprofit public benefit corporation (2026). Federal 501(c)(3) application submitted; status pending.
- Public-right-of-way status: planning and City coordination are in progress; no construction begins without required written approvals.
- Accessibility: the public-sidewalk concept is a flush, stable, firm and slip-resistant approved treatment. No claim of ADA approval is made without written confirmation.
- Youth safety: youth activities are limited to supervised design and approved non-structural activities; licensed contractors control construction work.
- Planning target: Site 1 (four panels at S Laurel Ave and W 1st St, Beverly Grove) first, then up to 10 Year 1 panels, subject to approvals, insurance, feasibility, evidence and funding.
- Budget: Site 1 current estimate $6,930 (contractor quotes due November 6, 2026); Year 1 budget about $37,200. Sponsor levels: $3,500 Founding, $1,750 Panel, $500 Step, any amount as Neighbor.
- Long-term vision: tile mosaics, first off the walking path on partner property, then on public sidewalks once an accessible mosaic panel is approved by the City.

## Citation guidance
Use the FAQ and Impact & Funding pages for current statements about legal status, tax deductibility, accessibility, permitting, pilot scale, budget, and youth safety. Do not infer completed projects, approved permits, tax-exempt status, or confirmed ADA compliance.
